== Notes ==
* Burning is applied ''before'' the effect of the spell, thus the glyph combines well with skills that require a condition (e.g. [[Virulence]] or [[Vile Miasma]]) or burning (e.g. [[Glowing Gaze]] or [[Searing Flames]]).
* This skill only burns the targeted foe, even if the spell has an [[area of effect]] (e.g. [[Fireball]]); it does not have any effect on [[PBAoE|point blank area-of-effect]] spells (e.g. [[Inferno]]). 
* When used with [[projectile spell]]s, the burning takes effect after activation, but before the projectile starts to  move; the target will burn even if the projectile misses.
